id.description: <phase slug>/<lesson slug>. The lesson slug must equal the folder name without its two-digit prefix.

short.description: Optional short label for the sidebar.

motto.description: One line stating the core idea. Rendered under the title.

type.description: Capstone: a graded project in phase 16 with starter/, solution/ and grader/ instead of code/.

status.description: draft: excluded from production builds. preview: built but unlisted. published: live.

tools.description: Real tools used in Use It (docker, kubectl, terraform...).

reference.description: Reference-layer docs this lesson builds on; each must exist under website/docs.

outputs.description: Artifacts in outputs/ produced by Ship It.

tests.description: One command per language, run from the lesson folder by scripts/run-lesson-tests.mjs. Capstones: the grader's own tests (grader/tests).

smoke.description: End-to-end check of Build It + Use It with the real tools, run on Linux CI by scripts/run-lesson-tests.mjs --smoke (lesson-smoke.yml). Sets last_verified when it passes.

last_verified.description: Date the commands were last run against current tool versions.

milestones.description: Capstone only. Milestone some-id is checked by check_some_id(project) in grader/checks.py.

pass_score.description: Capstone only. Points needed to pass; at most the milestone total.
